messages:
maya: quick sync — finalize newsletter + post-launch drip for Launchpad benchmark. goal: convert attendees to trials + capture feedback.

raj: sequence idea: immediate thank-you + recording, 48h tips (single CTA), 7d case study + 5q micro-survey, 14d demo invite. weekly digest for non-converters.

emma: segment by watch%: >=60% (power), 20-60% (warm), 0-20% or no-show. power -> SDR tag; warm -> nurture.

zach: subject variants: 'Launchpad: 3 quick wins', '10-min recap + recording', 'How teams cut inference cost' — rotate 3 variants. A/B test 24h vs 48h.

campaign-bot: campaign 'lp_benchmark_postlaunch_174321' scheduled sends: email0=1743213600, email1=1743386400, email2=1743828400, email3=1744433200. :robot_face:

maya: ops: include UTMs, hidden fields (watch_pct, resources, chat_flag), send window 9-14 local, suppress unsub instantly. owners: emma -> segments + survey; raj -> routing & scoring; zach -> subjects + experiment. i'll draft runbook and post here.
